This configuration defines how to track new releases for the `bb-rs` package, specifically by querying GitHub releases from the repository `epilys/bb`. The settings `use_latest_release = true` and `prefix = "v"` are standard and benign options used to detect version tags that start with "v".

There is no executable code in this file, nor any commands that perform network requests beyond what is expected from nvchecker's normal operation. The GitHub repository referenced (`epilys/bb`) is consistent with the package name `bb-rs`, indicating it is the legitimate upstream source. No obfuscation, suspicious URLs, or data exfiltration mechanisms are present.

This file serves only to configure version checking behavior and does not introduce any security risk. Its contents align with standard packaging practices for AUR helpers that track upstream releases.
